text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to resolve by-law amendments missed in Item TE11.35 "Residential On-street Permit Parking - Status Update on the Expansion of On-Street Permit Parking in the Toronto and East York Community Council Area". Transportation Services is recommending the approval of the parking regulations listed in Attachment 1 of this report. These proposed by-law amendments will ensure that the intent of Item TE11.35, as adopted with amendments by City Council on January 29, 2020 can be properly installed and enforced.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the parking regulations identified in Attachment 1 to the report (December 10, 2021) from the Director, Permits and Enforcement, Transportation Services.
